I replied to Pree in #central-team: the figure to use is 87 seats for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal.

Hollis first posted 268 in that channel on Oct 14, then corrected it the same day to 87 because they'd read the wrong line. Pree is in #central-team, so both messages were already visible to her. I told her to ignore the 268 that's still in the earlier thread.

The 87 hasn't been checked against a contract. It comes only from Hollis's correction, because I couldn't find any Marrow Fieldworks account files in the share.
